description: Sends one voltage to a random handful of its eight outputs and holds the others at 0V

params.text: Makes a fresh choice, as a rising edge at the trigger jack does
Sets how many of the eight outputs are in the draw, 0 to 8, counting from the first
Sets the share of those outputs that is switched on, 0 for none and 1 for all

inputs.text: A rising edge here makes a fresh choice of which outputs to switch on
The voltage sent to whichever outputs are switched on
Sets the share of the outputs in the draw that is switched on, 0V to 10V read as 0 to 1, and overrides the probability knob while patched
Sets how many outputs are in the draw, one output per volt, and overrides the selection knob while patched

outputs.text: Carries the input voltage while this output is switched on and 0V while it is not; the inner lamp shows it is switched on and the outer lamp that it is in the draw

notes: nothing moves until the trigger jack rises or the button is pressed, and the probability knob comes up at zero, so raise it before triggering

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
0 to 8V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
